findings.title: Library code wrote directly to console instead of an injectable logger
findings.observed: escalateReviews() called console.warn(...) directly in its catch branch on escalation failure.
findings.required: Library code never writes to stdout/stderr directly; it emits through an injectable logger. CLI owns console output.
findings.impact: A consumer embedding @alexvegman/assertions (e.g. inside another agent's process, or a test harness capturing stdout) cannot redirect, suppress, or assert on this diagnostic without monkey-patching global console.
findings.fix_hint: Add an optional injectable logger parameter defaulting to console to preserve current behavior.
